name: protecting-your-energy
description: Protecting Your Energy helps AI users spend less attention repairing avoidable agent mistakes, while keeping every personalization rule opt-in.

interface.shortDescription: Reduce AI busywork, re-asking, and unfinished follow-through.
interface.longDescription: A consent-first agent companion for reducing the energy users lose to repeated clarification, dropped context, premature stopping, and weak verification. It studies interaction friction, proposes scoped response policies, and asks before enabling them.
defaultPrompt: Finish the requested deliverable. Suggest opt-in effort-saving policies only when asked.
